name: proton-mail-bridge-client
description: Read, search, send, draft, and triage your Proton Mail inbox from Claude Desktop — entirely local via Proton Bridge, no third-party relay.
long_description: Read, search, send, draft and triage Proton Mail through a local Bridge connection and local SQLite index. The MCP transport is local, but a cloud AI client can transmit requested email content to its model provider. Use a local model if content must remain on this machine. Requires Proton Bridge to be installed, signed in and running.

protonmail_username.title: Proton Mail address
protonmail_username.description: Your full Proton Mail email address

protonmail_password.title: Bridge password
protonmail_password.description: Proton Bridge's own password (Bridge app -> account -> Mailbox details) — not your Proton account password
